Kongphouthakhoun wouldn't cooperate with troopers who believed he had been driving under the influence. Kongphouthakhoun reportedly pulled out a gun, and a CHP trooper shot and killed him.

name: Nan Ahao
circumstances: Officers were sent to investigate a noise complaint call between two neighbors, police said. When police arrived, they were told one neighbor had threatened to shoot the other neighbor during the dispute. Officers found the neighbor and tried to question him. Nan Zhao reportedly pulled out a handgun and fired at the officers. Officers shot and killed him.

name: Dominador Araquel Rabot
circumstances: A man, the victim, allegedly threatened probation officers with a "stabbing instrument" around 12:45 p.m. and was shot and killed.

name: Kevin Phoummany
circumstances: During a standoff during which the victim allegedly fired shots, he allegedly stabbed a police dog with a sword before he was shot and killed by Officer Joshua Hooyer.

name: Channara "Philly" Tom Pheap
circumstances: An officer was responding to a hit-and-run and encountered the victim. Thatâs when an altercation allegedly turned physical. The officer said the victim was able to gain control of the officerâs taser. The officer claimed he shot the victim after he felt what he said was âelectricity coursing through his body.â Plaintiffs said that the victim died of a gunshot to the back and therefore he did not âpose an immediate threat to the officer,â according to the lawsuit.

name: Dennis Carolino
circumstances: Police responded following a call just before 8 p.m. from a 70-year-old woman reporting Dennis Carolino, her nephew who lived with her, had thrown a brick at her. Two officers went to the home to handle the possible assault with a deadly weapon call. As officers attempted to arrest the man in the home's backyard, he allegedly advanced on them while swinging a shovel. The officers ordered him to drop the weapon, but he reportedly failed to disarm, and he was shot and killed.
initial_reason: domestic assault, assault with deadly weapon

name: Mauris Nishanga DeSilva
circumstances: Police responded to calls of a man pounding on neighbors' doors and threatening suicide. Police were told that the victim was armed with a knife and holding it to his own throat. Police located the victim and allege that he ignored commands and moved toward officers with the knife. Police then shot and killed him.
disposition_official: "charged, convicted deadly conduct, sentenced",Civil suit/Pending,dropping charges for 1 officer,appeal overturned conviction
officer_charged: charged with deadly conduct,"convicted, sentenced 2 yrs",dropping charges for one officer,appeal overturned conviction

name: Li Xi Wang
circumstances: Officers were serving a drug-related search warrant. When they entered the house, they found a 53-year-old woman who was taken into custody. As officers searched the house for more people, they found Li Xi Wang hiding behind a door. Video shows one officer telling the suspect to show his hands while another shot and killed him.

name: Aaron Hong
circumstances: Around 12:30 p.m., officers responded to a report of a man who was armed with a knife, covered in blood, and acting erratically. Aaron Hong was shot and killed when he threatened officers with the knife.
initial_reason: mental illness - acting erratically with knife

name: Jesse Sarey
circumstances: Police responded to calls of disorderly conduct, alleging that the victim had been throwing things at cars. An arriving officer attempted to take the victim into custody when an alleged scuffle ensued; the officer shot the victim, who then fell over and stayed on the ground. Surveillance video shows the officer then cleared a jammed bullet from his gun, looked around, and shot the victim again, killing him.
disposition_official: Charged with murder,Civil Suit/Family awarded settlement,Convicted ,appeal by officer
officer_charged: Convicted,Second-degree murder,Charged with 1st Degree Assault,sentenced 16 years

name: Saoun Pol
street_address: Castle Oaks Dr and Marlboro Ct
circumstances: Officers responded to investigate a report of a man armed with a baseball bat acting erratically. The victim allegedly refused to back down and continued to swing the bat, eventually moving toward officers. One officer shot and killed him.
initial_reason: person with a bat, erratic behavior

name: Shawna Widemann
circumstances: At 9:10 p.m., troopers received a 911 call about an unwanted person at the Stop Abusive Family Environments facility (SAFE). Shawna Widemann reportedly was armed with a claw hammer banging on the door. The SAFE facility was put into lock down status,. The troopers found Widemann, who was brandishing a claw hammer. She reportedly ignored orders from the troopers to drop the weapon and lunged at one of the troopers in a threatening manner. At least one trooper shot and killed her.
initial_reason: person with a weapon (claw hammer), disturbance at domestic violence center

name: Luc Ciel
circumstances: Police responded to a home invasion by an armed, estranged family member.  As officers arrived the victim, the suspect, had stabbed one person and was actively assaulting two youths. He had allegedly also stabbed himself multiple times. Police engaged the victim and allege that he moved toward them with a knife before they shot and killed him.
officer_names: Danielle Evans, Terrance Jackson, Jeffrey Tyner

name: Albert Thomas Dashow
circumstances: An officer tried pulling over a man in a Cub Foods parking lot. The victim pulled away and stopped  a short distance later. He allegedly struggled with officers and was taken to the ground. He tasered and died. The autopsy report listed obesity as a significant condition contributing to death, but listed restraint by law enforcement as the main cause of death.

name: Sokhom Hon
street_address: E 4th St and N Allen St
circumstances: Police said when an officer confronted Sokhom Hon, the man charged at them. In cellphone video, Hon is heard yelling at police, saying he wanted to die. Police ordered him to put the weapon down but were unsuccessful. An officer reportedly deployed less-lethal shotgun rounds to gain compliance and when that didn't work, officers deployed a Taser, which was also unsuccessful. At that point, the man allegedly charged at the officers and at least one officer shot and killed him.

name: Kasim Kahrim
circumstances: After 2:20 a.m., officers pulled over a vehicle, and the driver, Kasim Kahrim, reportedly exchanged gunfire with the officers, which wounded an officer. Kahrim fled after the exchange and was later found dead in the car.

name: Clayton Joseph
circumstances: Around 11 p.m., after police were dispatched to a report of a disturbance between a male and female at an apartment complex. Witnesses reported that two males, both possibly armed, had then become involved in a fight in the parking lot. Police said that Joseph brandished a knife when approached by officers and refused commands to drop the weapon before he was shot. Officer Roger Evans shot and killed Clayton Joseph.

name: Delmar Espejo
circumstances: An officer approached the victim, alleging that he had seen him with an open container of alcohol outdoors. A struggle reportedly ensued under unclear circumstances, and the officer alleges that the victim placed the officer in a headlock. The officer then shot and killed the victim.

name: Nam Quang Le
circumstances: Nam Le, 34, shot and killed four people he held hostage while police waited outside. Police then stormed the house and killed Nam Le. Two small children were released unharmed from the home several hours after the standoff began, police said. Killed were 30-year-old Lan Thi My Van, 28-year-old Le Thi My Van, 65-year-old Cho Thi Van, and Phung Minh Le, 28.

name: Phayvanh Inthavong
street_address: Arizona St and Churn Creek Rd
circumstances: Police received a 911 call about a man who was possibly armed with a handgun and acting erratically. The caller said the man might have been under the influence of drugs due to his behavior. When police arrived, the man saw them and began running through the neighborhood. Police said he ran through several yards and then broke into an occupied home. Police said he came out with a handgun and was shot and killed.

name: Siatu'u Tauai
circumstances: Three officers saw a truck weaving in and out of traffic around 1:30 a.m. They were all in separate patrol cars when they attempted to pull over Siatu'u Tauai. As the officers got out of the cars, the truck drove over an embankment to get away. The officers later caught up with Tauai. One officer sprayed him with pepper spray, but it didn't incapacitate him. He allegedly drove at officers and was shot and killed.

name: Nil Hoeur
circumstances: Police went to a residence after a 911 call where no one spoke. Arriving officers learned the victim was acting very erratically, was armed, and had taken a family member hostage. Police allege the victim would not engage with officers, leading to an extended standoff. Police later forcible entered a bedroom and allege that the victim was pointing a gun at the hostage and making threatening statements. Police then shot and killed him.

name: Iosia Faletogo
circumstances: Police attempted a traffic stop on the vehicle the victim was driving after observing an illegal lane change. Officers allege the victim refused to stop and fled from police, leading to a pursuit. Later, the victim allegedly exited his vehicle and fled on foot and discarded a gun he had in his waistband as he fled. Police caught the victim and took him bodily to the ground. An officer then shot and killed him as they allege he moved toward the discarded gun.
disposition_official: Justified by County Prosecutor,Civil Suit/Family awarded settlement

name: Kaulana "Toji" Reinhardt
street_address: Kaohu St and S Market Street
circumstances: Kaulana Reinhardt was wanted for attempted murder and was killed in a gunfight with police. Reinhardt allegedly was driving a stolen red Toyota Tacoma when he crashed into a front yard and then pulled out a handgun and exchanged shots with police.

name: Tori Mikaila Kaneshiro
circumstances: Police allege the victim was stopped on the side of the road with hazard lights on. And officers stopped to investigate and, after engaging with the victim, determined she had a warrant for her arrest. Police asked her to exit the car and allege that she refused and then grabbed a gun that was in the car and began to point it toward the officer when she was shot and killed.

name: Bert E. Mercado
circumstances: At 5:15 p.m., officers responded to a report of a who had stabbed himself with a knife at a home. When officers arrived, police say they were confronted by a man who had a rifle next to him. They said Bert Mercado grabbed the rifle, and the officers ordered him to drop it. He then pointed the rifle at the officers who shot Mercado. He retreated into the home, where police found him dead several hours later.

name: Andrew Kana
circumstances: Police were called to a bar to make contact with Andrew Kana who allegedly had several warrants. Kana was inside when they attempted to place him in custody for the warrants. Once one of Kana's wrists was placed in handcuffs, he allegedly failed to comply with orders for his other hand, pulled a firearm, and an officer shot and killed him.

name: Anovath Troy Kongvongxay
circumstances: Two officers were called to a home around 3:30 p.m. The two white male officers were confronted by an Asian man allegedly acting aggressively. Anovath Kongvongxay went inside a home and picked up an ax. Bobo said Kongvongxay thought he was going to be taken to jail and approached the officers swinging the ax. One officer shot and killed him.

name: Laudemer Atienza Arboleda
circumstances: Police responded to a call about a suspicious person. When police arrived, the victim was identified as the suspect and was told to stop, but allegedly refused. During a chase, the victim allegedly pulled over twice as though preparing to stop, then drove away as officers got out of their patrol vehicles. The second time while pulling away a deputy fired into his vehicle and killed him.
disposition_official: "Charged with voluntary manslaughter and assault with a deadly weapon, convicted of firearm assault",Charged
officer_charged: "Charged, Convicted, Sentenced to 6 years in prison",Appeal denied,Released Early

name: Kanwarbir Mahli
circumstances: Police located a car that had been reported stolen by the victim's mother the day earlier. In her report she told police that her son suffered from mental health issues. Police surrounded the vehicle with the victim inside and they allege that he would not comply with multiple orders. Police allege the victim made sudden movement and an officer shot and killed him.

name: Ashley Elisna Grammer
circumstances: Ashley Elisna Grammer allegedly rammed a stolen vehicle into a police SUV when she was shot and killed by police. Police said Grammer was a fugitive being sought on two $50,000 warrants.

name: Tison Dinney
circumstances: Police were called to assist state sheriffs with a man who was threatening another man with a machete and shears. The man had taken hedge shears apart and had half of it with a sharpened blade that was about two feet long. Police used pepper spray on the man after asking him to walk away from the weapons, but it was not effective. The man reportedly was ordered to move away from the weapons, but he did not comply. As officers approached the man to arrest him, he allegedly picked up one of the weapons and struck an officer in the torso. A second officer reportedly shocked him with a stun gun, and a third officer shot and killed him.
initial_reason: Person with a machete and hedge shears

name: Anthony Y. Tong
agency_responsible: Middleton Police Department, Dane County Sheriff's Office
circumstances: The victim allegedly shot four people at WTS Paradigm before being shot and killed by Middleton Police Officers Richard O'Connor and Tyler Loether and Dane County Sheriff's Deputies David Lambrecht and Matthew Earll.
officer_names: Richard O'Connor, Tyler Loether, David Lambrecht, Matthew Earll

name: Ryan Yamasaki
circumstances: About 4:15 a.m., police responded to a woman's call for help, police said. They broke into the house and inside they reportedly found the victim inside a closet armed with a box cutter and the screaming woman. The officers ordered the victim to drop the box cutter, but he allegedly "charged" at them with the box cutter and was shot and killed.
officer_names: Bridgette Ward, Matthew Brown, Zachary Winningham, Haven Tillmon

name: Birendra Thakuri
street_address: Federal Blvd and Stratford Lake Dr
circumstances: About 8:45 p.m., police were called on a report of several people fighting in the road, police said. The first officer contacted several men on the side of the road. Two men advanced and refused to obey the officer's commands. The victim was shot and killed.
disposition_official: Civil Suit,Qualified immunity,Justified by Prosecuting Attorney

name: Gavalynn Mahuka
circumstances: Officers were serving a temporary restraining order to Gavalynn Mahuka. Police said he fired shots from a shotgun after barricading himself inside his home for close to eight hours. Officers shot and killed him.

name: Justin Joshua Waiki
street_address: S Point Rd and Kamaoa Rd
circumstances: Justin Joshua Waiki was suspected of fatally shooting Officer Bronson Kaliloa during a traffic stop when he was shot and killed in a gunbattle with police.

name: Ngoc Dang Nguyen
circumstances: A man was shot and killed after a police chase in a vehicle and a crash where two bystanders were injured.

name: Raad Fakhri Salman
circumstances: Raad Fakhri Salman was holding his wife against her will at knifepoint, when Sgt. Brandon Hogan shot and killed him.

name: Larry San Nicolas
circumstances: Police were called to a house around 2:40 p.m. by a family member of Larry San Nicolas. The man was acting despondent, irrational and violent. When officers arrived, San Nicolas came out holding two samurai-type swords. When he refused to comply with commands from officers, an officer shot him with two bean bag rounds, which reportedly did not incapacitate him. He allegedly rushed toward the officers, and he was shot and killed.

name: Steven Allan Kaluahinui Hyer Jr.
circumstances: Police responded to calls regarding an agitated individual. He allegedly made multiple threats and stabbed a police dog with an arrow when he was shot and killed.

name: Renie Cablay
circumstances: Around 9:10 p.m., an officer responded to reports of a hit and run. When police caught up with a man believed to be the driver, he allegedly threatened the officer with a knife, then went into an apartment. Officers followed him into the second-story apartment and shot and killed him when he allegedly lunged at an officer with the knife.

name: Robert George Issa
circumstances: Officers were called at about 7:30 a.m. on a domestic call. The caller told dispatchers that a family member was being "assaultive" and had multiple knives. Police said Robert George Issa ran at the vehicles and tried gaining access. A Taser reportedly was deployed but was ineffective. Issa allegedly continued moving forward and refused to comply with commands. He was shot and killed.

name: Nathaniel Prasad
circumstances: At about 6:47 p.m. undercover police spotted a man, who was a passenger in a vehicle. Marked police patrol vehicles were called and stopped the vehicle using their lights and sirens, and the suspect ran to the ARCO. Police followed and exchanged gunfire with the man, who was killed. Police said the man was wanted on a felony warrant for illegal possession of a firearm and a probation violation.
initial_reason: Warrant (felony illegal possession of firearm, parole violation)

name: Jehad Eid
circumstances: At around 4:34 p.m., officers were called to the area of Geneva and London on reports of a man with a gun. Officers went to a nearby barber shop, where a gun battle erupted. An officer was shot in the leg and was transported to San Francisco General Hospital. Five other people were wounded in the shooting. Lehad Eid, the alleged suspect, was killed.

name: Steven Nguyen
circumstances: Steven Nguyen was killed after a high-speed chase that began as part of a day-long manhunt for attempted murder suspect Mauricio Venzor-Gonzalez, who escaped from custody at Denver Health Medical Center.

name: Hieu Than
circumstances: Officers were dispatched to a home about 5 p.m. for a welfare check after someone called 9-1-1 and hung up. When the two officers arrived, a man partially opened the door, and one officer asked if he could come inside. The man opened the door and the officer took a step or two inside, at which point a second man, identified as the victim, allegedly charged at him with a knife. The officers backed away, but the victim reportedly continued to charge at the officers, who shot and killed him.

name: Peter Le
circumstances: Peter Le, 52, allegedly killed his own father, Quyen Le, 86, before he was shot and killed by police. A 911 caller told dispatch around 10:30 p.m. that one of his brothers was harassing their father at their home. When police arrived, the front door was open, and an officer saw Peter Le standing with a knife and gun in his hands inside the home, police said. The officer ordered the younger Le to drop the weapon, but he continued to threaten to harm his father for several minutes, and refused to drop either weapon. Peter Le then fatally shot his father, and the officer shot and killed Le.

name: Thompson Nguyen
circumstances: Officers responding to a 911 call about a lost/confused man encountered the victim as he was reportedly walking around a power plant with a hatchet. Police claim the victim walked off and ignored officers asking him to drop the hatchet; the victim allegedly circled around and approached a patrol car. According to police, he refused to drop the hatchet and repeatedly told officers to shoot him; as he reportedly approached the patrol car's open door, officers shot and killed him.

name: Andy Vo
circumstances: Andy Vo was fatally shot by Long Beach police after he allegedly held Holiday Inn employees hostage with a gun, police said. Few details were immediately released.

name: Ahmed Aminamin El-Mofty
circumstances: Ahmed Aminamin El-Mofty was shot and killed during an alleged driving gun battle with police, police said.

name: Vernchoy Saechao
circumstances: Police said they encountered Vernchoy Saechao while investigating a domestic disturbance call reported just after 2 a.m. Saechao, police said, fired a handgun at an officer before the officer shot and killed him.

name: Bijan Ghaisar
circumstances: Police responded to calls of a minor car accident. They allege that the victim was one of the people involved and that he drove away from investigating police. Officers located and pursued the victim. Police allege that the victim stopped for police, and then drove away from them multiple times. Officers then stood in front of the car and, as they allege the victim pulled the car forward again, they shot and killed him.
disposition_official: Civil Suit/Family awarded settlement,cleared by US Attorney

name: Nyung Kyee
circumstances: A Clarksville Police Department officer pulled over a vehicle, and the driver allegedly stepped out and brandished a weapon. The officer shot and killed Nyung Kyee.

name: Phumee Lee
circumstances: Police responded to a domestic violence call. Officers spoke with a woman who indicated the victim had shot a gun at her before leaving. She said that the victim had been drinking and using drugs. Police located the victim walking nearby and allege that he refused orders to stop before he raised and fired a gun at them. Officers then shot and killed him.

name: Farhad Jabbari
circumstances: Farhad Jabbari was able to move his cuffed arms from behind his back to the front of his body as he was sitting in the back of a Saginaw Township police cruiser, police said. When two officers apparently tried to recuff him, something happened. Jabbari was killed and an officer shot, but who shot the police officer, or why Jabbari was killed, weren't immediately released.

name: Tommy Le
circumstances: King County Sheriff's Office deputies were called to a home following a report that a man armed with a knife had attacked someone at the home. The apparent victim fired a warning shot at his assailant before retreating into his house. Deputies arrived to find the man still armed with a knife, police said. One deputy fatally shot the man after two shots from a Taser stun gun failed to bring him down. It turned out to be a pen.

name: Isaiah Obet
street_address: D St SE and 21st St SE
circumstances: Police responded to reports of a man trying to break into houses and behaving erratically. An officer confronted the victim as he allegedly attempted a carjacking with a knife. Police shot the victim and sent a dog at him; the victim fell over. The officer claims the victim then tried to get back up, at which the officer shot the victim again, killing him.
disposition_official: Civil Suit/Family awarded settlement,Justified by DA
officer_known_past_shootings: 1 prior - Brian Scaman, 1 subsequent - Jesse Sarey

name: Naway Willy
circumstances: Police were investigating a murder. When they attempted to interrogate Marc Davis, he fled. As they chased him, he produced a gun and was shot and killed.

name: Joseph Tourino
circumstances: Joseph Tourino reportedly charged at police while holding knives. He apparently had history of mental illness and prior skirmishes with police, police said.

name: Joseph Sin
circumstances: Officers noticed Joseph Sin, 43, leaning into the window of a car in the parking lot of an Econolodge. After officers approached the suspect to see if the car was his, he ran away, police said. After police chased Sin, a shootout ensued. One officer was shot in the leg during the shooting and was treated and released. Sin was shot and killed.

name: Phosowath Sengphong
circumstances: Phosowath Sengphong was fatally shot by an Iberia Parish Sheriff's Office deputy after he allegedly brandished a knife.

name: Nengmy Vang
circumstances: Vang allegedly got into a domestic incident with his wife and went to the Rothschild bank where she worked. He allegedly shot two bank employees to death and then traveled to nearby Schofield, where he shot and killed his wife's divorce attorney. He then barricaded himself in his Weston apartment. Police allege that he shot and killed an Everest Metro Police detective as the detective was setting up a perimeter. Police eventually stormed the apartment and shot and killed Vang.
officer_names: Everest Metropolitan Police Department Detective Sergeant Dan Goff and Marathon County Sheriff's Deputy Matthew Bell

name: Charles Kosi Jr.
circumstances: The victim was killed after allegedly breaching a TSA security checkpoint at the Honolulu International Airport. He reportedly tried to skip the line and fought when "detained."

name: Pekelo Sanchez
circumstances: Sanchez was in a stolen pickup, asleep. When police attempted to talk to him, he rammed the apartments in front of the car and several vehicles before being shot and killed.
officer_names: Dylan Shatto, Marvin Parengit, Barbara Delaforce

name: Yia Lee
circumstances: Two men were in custody at the DPS office for a criminal charge of transporting drugs. One of the suspects, Yia Lee, produced a loaded handgun and fired at the two deputies. The deputies shot and killed him.

name: Sinuon Pream
circumstances: Officers responded to a call of a woman with a knife confronting several homeless people outside a Jack in the Box. Upon arrival, police encountered the victim and shot and killed her.

name: Cameron John Johnson
circumstances: Officers were called with a report of a stolen truck. An officer tracked down the truck and ordered the victim to stop. He allegedly struck the officer with the truck and the officer shot and killed the victim.
disposition_official: Pending investigation/No Known Charges,Civil suit/Family awarded money

name: Hafez Abousamra
circumstances: After an attempted driving while drunk stop, the victim allegedly shot at police officers, fled, tried to break into a house, and shot at police again before being shot and killed.
officer_names: SWAT team arrived, Abousamra continued firing at them, and was killed.

name: Zhonghua Li
circumstances: Li suffering from mental health issues attacking family members with a pair of scissors was shot and killed by deputies. He allegedly threatened the deputies with the scissors.

name: Stephen Joshua Whitney
circumstances: Police say they were searching for 30-year-old Stephen Joshua Whitney of Hilo who was a suspect in an attempted murder investigation during a domestic incident. Police say Whitney drove at an officer with a stolen truck, and he was shot and killed.

name: Saif Nasser Mubarak Alameri
circumstances: According to police, Saif Nasser Mubarak Alameri was driving on the Ohio Turnpike when he sideswiped another vehicle and flipped his vehicle. He climbed out of his car and fled the scene before the Ohio State Highway Patrol arrived. Around an hour later, a Hudson police officer found him in a nearby wooded area off of Hudson-Aurora Road. There was a struggle between the officer and the man, and he was shot and killed.

name: Luke Smith
circumstances: Police responded when two people were stabbed. After speaking to responders, Smith fled. When police caught up with him, he threatened them with a knife. Police said they tried some less-lethal methods to stop him, before they shot and killed him.

name: Jun Wang
circumstances: Officers had gone to the condo to serve a probate order because of the victim's schizophrenia. The police allege that Wang, who spoke Mandarin and did not understand English, became defiant during the encounter, grabbed a knife and stabbed an officer's face and leg, police said. The officer's partner shot and killed Wang.

name: Junef Monzon
circumstances: Officers spotted a stolen vehicle in Murrieta. When they tried to stop the driver of the vehicle, the person fled, police said. After reportedly leading police in a chase up the freeway, the driver got off on Bundy Canyon Road in Wildomar and continued down several city streets before crashing into a fence. After crashing into the fence, the victim allegedly crashed into multiple Murrieta police cruisers before driving toward officers, when he was shot and killed.
disposition_official: Pending investigation/No Known Charges,civil suit/dismissed (qualified immunity)
officer_names: Scott Montez, Chris Zeltner, Kyle Mikowski, Zach Bradley, Blake Williams

name: Michael L. Taylor
street_address: Airport Way S and S Stacy St
circumstances: Seattle police fatally shot Taylor after encountering a fight near The Jungle as city crews were moving out the last remaining residents of the troubled homeless camp.

name: Nathan DeSai
circumstances: DeSai wounded nine people after he began randomly shooting at passing cars before he was 'neutralized' by officers, according to police. Authorities are unsure what caused DeSai's shooting spree but said Nazi emblems were found in his clothing.

name: Silivenusi Pacelli Namato Ravono
agency_responsible: Marin County Sheriff's Office, Central Marin Police Authority
circumstances: The victim was taken to Marin General Hospital's emergency department by a friend because he was acting erratically, police said. When he left the hospital, hospital staff notified the Marin County Sheriff's Office. The Central Marin Police Authority found the victim in the area of South Eliseo Drive. He allegedly resisted the police officers and sheriff's deputies. He was handcuffed, placed in custody, and taken to the Psychiatric Emergency Services. He allegedly continued to fight until he became unresponsive and died.

name: BJ Medeiros
circumstances: Police were called to Hawaiian Paradise Park for a suicidal, armed man. Police say Medeiros struggled with one police officer over a .45 caliber gun. When the handgun was pointed at that officer, another officer fired one shot killing Medeiros.

name: Walden Dang
circumstances: Police responded to a call regarding a suicidal man. When they came back to the apartment, Dang threatened them with a knife and was shot and killed.

name: Barry Prak
circumstances: Federal officers requested located the victim, a suspect in a shooting in 2014, and asked local officers for help in serving an arrest warrant. Prak allegedly charged at officers, and they used a foam weapon and a K9. As the victim then held a knife and moved toward officers again, police shot and killed him.

name: Mohammad Sadegh Moghaddam
circumstances: Moghaddam was shot dead by police after opening fire inside a Texas Walmart where he worked before taking two people hostage.

name: Omar Mir Seddique Mateen
circumstances: Mateen killed at least 48 people at the Pulse nightclub in Orlando. He was shot and killed. It was the largest mass murder by a single individual in U.S. history.

name: Thongsoune Vilaysane
circumstances: After an attempted traffic stop, Vilaysane fled. Eventually, he was surrounded, and he responded by running into police cars with his. He was shot and killed.

name: Cin Lam Mung
circumstances: Responding to calls about a suspicious person, police allege that they tried to talk with the victim. Police allege that he refused to drop something that resembled a machete. Police allege that they shot him when he advanced toward them with the weapon.

name: Sylasone Ackhavong
circumstances: Responding to a suicide call, police allege that a gunman barricaded himself in the store. Charlotte-Mecklenburg police and a SWAT unit arrived. Officers with the SWAT team shot and killed 41-year-old Sylasone Ackhavong during the standoff after he raised a gun at officers, police said.

name: Map Kong
circumstances: Officers responded to a call about a man acting suspiciously outside the McDonalds off Hwy. 13 and Washburn Avenue. They confronted the victim, who police allege was brandishing a knife, and shot and killed him.
officer_names: Patrick Gast, Maksim Yakovlev, Taylor Jacobs, John Mott, LynRae Tonne

name: Sunny Chin
circumstances: Police say officers responded to a domestic disturbance call. Once on scene, officers spoke to Sunny Chin, 53, who they say refused to cooperate and pointed a handgun at them, misfired, and when back into the house. Later, Chin came out of the house and onto his carport, with a gun tucked into a towel around his waist. Officers approached the suspect while carrying a shield, and ordered him to keep his hands visible and not fire on them. Chin then reportedly reached for the weapon at his waist and fired one shot, which hit the shield. Officers then shot and killed Chin.

name: Scottie I.K. Yanagawa
circumstances: The victim was wanted for his alleged involvement in a Jan. 31 shooting at Honolii that left a Kona man hospitalized and for furlough escape from Hale Nani Reintegration Center in Hilo on Nov. 19. Police say a traffic stop was made on a Toyota minivan known to be operated by the victim, who was described Monday in a wanted bulletin as armed and dangerous. Officers commanded the victim, who they say was in the passenger seat, and the female driver to get out of the van. He, while getting out of the van, allegedly shot at officers with a handgun, police say. Four officers shot and killed him.

name: Thongsavanh Vandarack
circumstances: Two Loudon County Sheriff's Office investigators went to the home to serve a warrant for aggravated statutory rape of a 13-year-old. The man's girlfriend invited officers into the home, the 40-year-old male suspect was instructed to take his hands out of his pocket. When he did, police said the suspect pulled out a gun. The officers shot and killed him.
